Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Hänt Extra is the Macedonian weekly simply because it is a weekly magazine and Tea Moderna searches returned noise. This ignored clear evidence that Hänt Extra is Swedish and failed to pursue proper queries for Tea Moderna (e.g., adding “magazine,” “Macedonia,” site:.mk, or the Macedonian spelling “Теа Модерна”). The faulty inference and insufficient, misdirected search for Tea Moderna led directly to the wrong solution.
